description: Shape Gauge Plume turns any shape into a gauge: a barrel, a bottle or a drop fills up with color to show a percentage. Drop a Value and a Target (or a Minimum and a Maximum), pick a shape, and the fill rises to the right level. Free features, no watermark 22 free shapes, including containers that fill only their inside: drop, circle, heart, person, house, barrel, bottle, glass, wine glass, thermometer and battery. Fill: bottom to top, top to bottom, left to right or right to left, with a wavy surface and an animated fill. Colors: single color (also driven by a DAX measure) or one color per category; empty part, container and outline. Labels and marks: two-tone percentage or value label, target line, visible overflow above 100%. One shape per category in an automatic grid, sorted by value or name. Power BI: tooltips, cross-filtering, highlighting, right-click menu, keyboard, screen readers, high contrast, English and French. Premium features ★ 131 more shapes, including 15 more containers that fill only their inside: tank, beaker, test tube, hourglass, mug. Your own SVG pasted or returned by a measure (sanitized), with the logo's original colors. Circular fill with a start angle, and radial fill.
